topic: Class Declaration and Definition in Modern C++
explanation: In C++, classes are user-defined types that encapsulate data members and member functions, enabling object-oriented programming. Declaring a class defines a new type that can be instantiated into objects, supporting features like encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. Modern C++ emphasizes clear class definitions with constructors, destructors, and access specifiers to manage object lifetimes and interface design effectively.
keywords: C++ class definition, class declaration, user defined types, C++ classes
